[*Read the report*](https://kylecapybara.github.io/2026-grfp-winners/) · [*View the source on GitHub*](https://github.com/kylecapybara/2026-grfp-winners)

This project explores the 2026 National Science Foundation Graduate Research Fellowship awards. I was especially interested in how award fields connect to institutions, career stages, and the path into Chemical Engineering graduate programs.

The analysis separates senior undergraduates from first-year graduate students when the award data makes that possible. It also compares a winner's baccalaureate institution with their current institution, then uses those relationships to examine institutional pathways in Chemical Engineering and other highly represented fields.

The report includes yearly award counts, inferred career stages, graduate-school destinations, institutional concentration, baccalaureate sources, broad fields, and engineering topics. The figures and tables come from a Python notebook and are presented in a Quarto report so the analysis can be rerun and read as one document.

The public repository does not include person-level award data. It includes the cleared analysis outputs, aggregate tables, figures, and the instructions needed to reproduce the report with an appropriate local copy of the source data.
